note: Every action except generate_network is stripped before generating, so a record's own simulate protocol never runs; the suites declare the horizons. generate_network options are kept -- they decide the network. A model may additionally declare a deterministic 'relax' step, which is run before the .net is written so the artifact carries the relaxed state as its seed; a relax horizon must be past convergence, and its 'why' records the evidence.

models.name: gene_bursts
models.reference: Lin YT, Doering CR (2016) Phys Rev E 93:022409.

relax.why: The model's own protocol -- in the record and in the superseded source alike -- relaxes deterministically and carries that state into the SSA run; it is never simulated stochastically from the bare 0/0 seeds. Manuscript Table 5 runs a single cell cycle (t_end=3600), so without the relaxation the row measures the basal regime: median 95 events over 200 seeds, with 25 of 200 replicates measuring exactly 0. The horizon is converged and therefore not a free parameter: 3.6e5, 3.6e6 and 3.6e7 s all give mRNA=0.389150, Protein=466.979857 to every digit BNG prints, while the record's own 3.6e4 s stops at 111.741368, still climbing. 3.6e5 is the value the superseded actions block used, and it reproduces the Protein=467 the previous .net had baked in, so the manuscript's B07 measurement does not move.
